main_language_review: A: lexical do-support is distinguished from ordinary be, existing auxiliaries, imperative Don’t be and valid negative/split infinitives; scope of promise and no/not is retained.
B: the stated neutral standard register is distinguished from negative concord without judging speakers; scope, not unhappy/impossible and neither/nor are not reduced to word counting.

C: corrected film chronology uses an explicitly earlier start; continuing learning, fixed dates and last/first experience reference are stated before transformation. Context can supply a past reference outside one sentence.
D: could plus and we did explicitly proves success; possibility alone does not. Advice has a known recipient; prohibition, no necessity, past obligation and past deduction remain distinct.

E: changed information focus does not license loss of a required named agent, recipient, tense/aspect/modality, negation or question force. Unknown/unimportant agents may be omitted only in stated contexts.

F: speaker/addressee/reporter/time/place establish pronouns and deictics; request/command and scope of not stay distinct; both contextually valid backshift choices are acknowledged without a physics-dependent universal rule.
